text:
jess: Noting a surge of mTLS handshake failures in eu-central after today's RBAC tweak to kms-decrypt for svc-ingress. Observed ~3% of sessions failing with "tls: decryption failed" and retries spiking.
rafael: tagging @zoe — are we rolling any new KMS bindings in eu today?
zoe: I merged an infra PR that consolidated IAM bindings across regions at +30m. It replaced explicit key ARNs with a region wildcard for convenience.
arman: hmm wildcarded KMS resource ARNs can be treated differently by HSM-backed keys. paste the deny event?
security-bot: ALERT: KMS_ACCESS_DENIED user=svc-ingress principal=svc-ingress-prod action=Decrypt key=arn:aws:kms:eu-central-1:222:key/1234-abcd error=AccessDenied ts=2025-02-03T09:12:01Z
jess: attached log snippet from proxy showing handshake error chain and subsequent 504s.
rafal: small nit: our proxies inline-decrypt session keys via KMS for mTLS termination. If Decrypt fails it leads to connection aborts, not a security breach, but availability impact.
zoe: rolling back that IAM patch now to explicit key ARNs. PR#: https://git.company/infra/ops/merge/4321
arman: mitigation checklist I pushed to the incident channel: (1) revert IAM change, (2) switch eu-central proxy to fallback key (regional), (3) disable 0-RTT at edge for eu- region, (4) increase KMS audit retention for impacted key to 90d.
security-bot: KMS POLICY EVAL: detected resource pattern with wildcard: arn:aws:kms:eu-*:222:key/* in recent commit infra/4321. Recommendation: disallow wildcards for HSM-type keys.
jess: can we add a pre-commit lint that fails on kms ARN wildcards? We should also require key type check via aws:ViaService or kms:CallerAccount?\ozoe: will add a linter. Also adding a unit test that simulates decrypt errors for HSM keys if wildcard present.
arma n: (typo) sorry: arman: Also adding an alert: metric tls_decrypt_errors{region=~"eu.*"} > 2/min for 5m triggers P2.
rafael: followups for postmortem: root cause = overly-broad IAM resource pattern + HSM policy strictness. Contributing factors: no CI lint, no alert for region decrypt errors, 0-RTT amplification.
jess: vulnerability triage: CONFIRMED no data exfiltration. Impact: availability-only. Severity: Sev3.
zoe: infra change merged at +4m reverted at +12m. Error rate normalized by +25m after fallback key routing.\security-bot: Audit export: saved 720 raw KMS events to secure-logs:euc-archive for 90d. Query sample: resource="arn:aws:kms:eu-central-1:222:key/1234-abcd" AND eventName=Decrypt AND errorCode=AccessDenied
arman: action items: (1) add KMS wildcard lint (owner: zoe), (2) alert rule for tls_decrypt_errors (owner: arman), (3) disable 0-RTT per-region toggle (owner: infra), (4) add CI test for HSM-backed key behavior (owner: zoe), (5) update runbook for KMS decrypt fallback and add playbook steps (owner: jess).
rafal: I'll own the postmortem doc and include timeline + CI link.
zoe: PRs: lint -> https://git.company/infra/changes/4334, revert -> https://git.company/infra/changes/4335.
jess: Thanks all. Leaving this open until postmortem + CI lint is merged. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deployment rollbacks completed: 2 services rolled back, 1 canary switched to fallback key, 0 unsafely retried connections detected.
